'''xcshort The Better Version of Hunt Down the Rebel Fleet''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[xcshort]]
* '''Published:''' 9 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed HD xcshort DS 2003 TheBette.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

The suggested improvements in place the strategy remains the same.  Use Commander Gherant to get out the rest of the Executor sites. Then use the You Cannot Hide Forever& Mobilization Points to get the Executor if not already in play then lose the effect to get Flagship Opperations. Start deploying TIE Intercepter and deploying capitals to their locations.

Flagship Opperations- Flagship Executor becomes a big tank.

Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser-With Oppressive Enforcements in play they are a destiny of 4, add 1 to the power of TIEs and are pretty cheap to deploy.

Accuser-Very cheap to deploy as a react to a system where my opponent have ganged up on a Few TIE Interceptors after Flagship Opperations is in play.

Flagship Executor-Tank Tank Tank.

Mara Jade-She can help hunt Luke.
